# v1.0 release decision

**Decision:** Pending

This document is an unsigned template. It is not permission to publish. The
programme executive and independent release-assurance authority must review the
generated criterion matrix, all gate decisions, unresolved conditions and the
release artefact before recording a decision.

Required fields are release identifier, immutable artefact digest, governance-pack
digest, decision, conditions, decision date, and the genuine names, roles and dates
of every accountable signatory. Blank fields must never be inferred or populated
from role labels.
